timelineNodes.label: Caster past revealed
timelineNodes.summary: Caster's betrayal past is revealed and Shirou dreams of the Fuyuki fire.

timelineNodes.label: Illya killed
timelineNodes.summary: Gilgamesh kills Berserker and removes Illya's heart while Shinji mocks.

timelineNodes.label: Lancer offers alliance
timelineNodes.summary: Lancer intervenes and proposes alliance with Rin and Shirou.

cause: Rin and Shirou seek Illya as an ally against Caster, but Gilgamesh has already attacked.
process: The party arrives too late; Gilgamesh kills Berserker and Illya, then Lancer joins Rin and Shirou out of opposition to Gilgamesh and Archer.
outcome: Illya and Berserker are eliminated in UBW, and Lancer becomes a temporary ally.
stateChanges: Lancer shifts into alliance with Rin/Shirou
relationshipChanges: Lancer opposes Gilgamesh and Archer alongside Rin/Shirou
